releaseNotes:
Judge fixes, official-style result and history panels, and a format button.

- Run and Submit were both broken against leetcode.cn. The code must be sent as typed_code (the plugin sent codedetail, so the server answered "解答提交 POST 数据丢失"), verdicts now poll /submissions/detail/<id>/check/ for runs and /v2/check/ for submissions, and state is PENDING / SUCCESS / FAILURE / REVOKED — waiting for the legacy "Finished" made every judge burn the whole poll budget and report a timeout even after the answer had already been accepted.
- Result fields are mapped to what the check endpoints actually return (std_output / std_output_list, compare_result, total_correct, total_testcases, last_testcase, full_compile_error, full_runtime_error), so the verdict panel shows output instead of blanks.
- Submission history fixed: submissionList declares offset and limit as non-null; omitting offset made the server answer "发生未知错误，请联系管理员".
- UI: verdict card (status + 执行用时 / 内存消耗 / 通过用例 + 输入 / 输出 / 预期结果) and a history table laid out like the site; new 格式化 button using prettier for JavaScript and TypeScript, whitespace-only normalisation elsewhere (prettier has no parser for Go / Python / Java / C++ / Rust, and brace-depth re-indenting would corrupt indentation-significant languages).
- Verified locally on a real signed-in session: run and submit return verdicts in seconds, the history table renders, formatting works.
